note: Coverage ledger of the motions safety net. `primitives[].tests` and `laws[].tests` name tests that exercise the symbol or the row; `laws[].audit` names the spec-audit sweep that runs every check of `checks` on the row. A primitive without tests, and a law row without an audit, is open work. `sweep` is `reduced` while the audit runs on the temporary reduced body set, `full` on all fourteen bodies.
